observed: Result: Passed on staging, following the test's steps.
Analytics, judged by the events the browser sent to Google Analytics (fresh session).

Tech View and then Board View each sent 1 more (running total 3); the Estimates tab and then the All tab each sent 1 more (running total 5).

Seen: Board View sent 13 field-load events, one per optional field; VIN/serial was on with source saved and every other field had source default; plus 1 density-load event (as expected).

Tech View sent 17 field-load events, not the 15 the test expects: the two extra are On Site (vehicle_here) and Unit; plus 1 density-load event. Board View, List and Board View again sent no new field or density events. Session total 13 + 17 = 30 (the test expects 28).

The product requirement (PRD version 58, read 16 Oct 2026, S5-R4 and S5-R4a) now makes On Site and Unit optional Tech View columns: "On Site, VIN/Serial # and Lead Technician are off by default; each can be added with the column chooser" and "Every other Tech View column, Unit included, can be turned off with the column chooser." So 17 follows the requirement; the test's 15 was written before that change.
